scope: First 50 agencies in catalog order; official system maps and rider guides.

statusRules.numeric_definition_on_map: The official system map visibly names frequent/high-frequency service and gives a numeric threshold or range.
statusRules.qualitative_definition_on_map: The official system map visibly names frequent/high-frequency service without a numeric threshold.
statusRules.no_definition_on_map: The official system map was reviewed but contains no named frequent/high-frequency definition.
statusRules.map_unavailable: No official system map could be located or accessed for review.
statusRules.pending_map_review: The map has not yet been reviewed.

evidenceRules: Only current official system maps and rider guides count toward the verified chart.
Official route pages, schedules, planning documents, and general service bands are not substitutes for a system map or rider-guide definition.
Record the exact map wording and page/legend location; do not paraphrase a definition into existence.
Preserve a local PDF or image with the correct extension whenever technically practical.
A missing current map or missing map definition is a valid result and must not be converted into a numeric definition.
